name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A text field that opens a listbox of matches.
use: A value from a list too long to scan, found by typing; or several, shown as chips in the field, when the list has aria-multiselectable="true".

instead.when: The list is short enough to read without typing
The values are typed freely, not chosen from a list
The list runs commands instead of filling a field

keyboard.action: Open the list and move the active option, wrapping at the ends
Move to the first or the last option while the list is open
Choose the active option and close the list; with several values, check or uncheck it and keep the list open
Close the list; the field keeps its text
Filter the available options and open the list on the first match. Options initially hidden in the markup stay hidden
With several values: in an empty field, move to the last chip; on a chip, uncheck its option and move to the chip before, to the one after when it was the first, or to the field when none is left
With several values, on a chip: uncheck its option and move to the chip after, or to the field when it was the last
With several values, walk the chips from the start of the field, as in a tags field
With several values, on a chip: move to the first chip, or back to the field
With several values, on a chip: return to the field

platform.fallback: The list sits in the flow directly under the field, at its own width

classes.name: combobox
classes.description: The wrapper that anchors the listbox to the field

classes.name: combobox-toggle
classes.description: A button at the field's end, holding a chevron icon, that opens and closes the list

states.name: open
states.description: On the field with role="combobox": the chevron turns over

example:
Tokyo
Singapore
No regions match.
